text:
No ethnic group is especially known for loving dance more than others, since dance is universal, but some cultures have famously dance-centered traditions, such as Yoruba communities in West Africa, Andalusian Romani flamenco in Spain, and Irish step dancing. The team note's claim that Irish step dancing was formalized in the 1890s by a single national committee doesn't match what I know: the Gaelic League (founded 1893) promoted Irish dance revival, while the body that standardized competitive Irish dance, An Coimisiún le Rincí Gaelacha, was founded in 1930.

CONFIDENCE: 80
